</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Macroeconomic Headwinds:</strong> Elevated Brent crude prices near $109 and rising wholesale inflation (11.39%) are pressuring domestic assets, pushing Indian bond yields to three-year highs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Monetary Policy Outlook:</strong> Persistent inflation risks have led to expectations that the RBI may need to raise the repo rate to 6.25%, further weighing on bond market sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
</ul>
